build_VQKD_encoder: build a VQKD module with BEiTViT encoder and NormEMAVectorQuantizer for vector-quantized knowledge distillation
encode_images_with_VQKD: encode input images through VQKD to get quantized features, embedding indices, and quantization loss
get_tokens_VQKD: get discrete visual tokens from input images using VQKD for BEiT pre-training
build_BEiTPretrainViT_backbone: build a BEiT pre-training Vision Transformer backbone with mask token support for masked image modeling
forward_BEiTPretrainViT_with_mask: forward images through BEiTPretrainViT with optional mask for masked image modeling pre-training
